chapter: New York, church bands and early training
title: Pianola, Mr. Marshall's ragtime and Lucky Roberts
summary: The ragtime he heard was mostly on the pianola and Marshall's dance-school playing; he knew of the fine pianist Lucky Roberts.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: mean around were you hearing, I mean were ragtime piano players around. Did you hear all that or what was the --
No, at the time what I heard was more or less a pianola --
Do you remember what a pianola is?

Mr. Marshall was also a pianist, but he was not what you would call a "ragtime piano player." He played ragtime but it was for the dance schools and everything. I'm trying to think -- yes, I did know and did hear one wonderful piano player. His name was Lucky Roberts.
Yeh, Lucky Roberts, and I never played with him, but he was a member of the Amsterdam and the Clef clubs.
